Class Progression

java.lang.Object
stawa.vitalstrike.Progression
public final class Progression extends Object
Kill feedback and RPG levelling. Every kill pops a "slain" marker over the victim and pays experience scaled to the victim's max health; the level is derived from lifetime experience.
